text: Similarly, just as the three streams of the Ganges, falling from the peak of Mount Rudra, form a single current, so too does the unmanifest, three-guṇa reality give rise to the manifest. Or, just as threads, when combined, produce a cloth, so does the unmanifest, through the arising of the guṇas, give rise to Mahat and so on. Thus, the manifest world arises from the three-guṇa unmanifest.
